instrucciones: For questions 17–24, read the text below. Use the word given in capitals at the end of some of the lines to form a word that fits in the gap in the same line.
texto:
Keeping bees on a city rooftop might seem an {{17}} hobby, yet it has become remarkably popular in recent years. Many new keepers are surprised by the {{18}} of the insects, since they had expected them to be aggressive. In fact, a calm keeper wearing the right clothing is rarely stung. The {{19}} of urban hives has also benefited local gardens, because the bees pollinate flowers and vegetables across a wide area.

There are, of course, some problems to consider. Neighbours may worry that swarms could {{20}} passers-by, and a hive left {{21}} for several weeks can quickly become a nuisance. Veteran keepers therefore advise newcomers to join a local association, where they can learn from {{22}} members who have dealt with every kind of difficulty. The honey itself is often an {{23}} delight, as its flavour depends on which trees and plants happen to grow nearby. Many keepers are {{24}} proud of the result, and they happily give jars to friends as presents.

items.explicacion: Adjective with a negative prefix: "an unlikely hobby" is one you would not expect. The article "an" and the contrast with "yet it has become popular" confirm it.
A noun is needed after "the" and before "of the insects": gentle + -ness = gentleness.
Noun after "The", followed by "of urban hives". Note the change from -ent to -ence.
A verb is needed after "could": fright + -en = frighten, meaning to make people afraid.
Adjective with a negative prefix after "left": "left unattended" means with nobody looking after it.
Adjective before "members": experience + -d = experienced, meaning having a lot of practical knowledge.
Adjective with a negative prefix and suffix: un- + predict + -able. The flavour changes depending on what grows nearby, so it cannot be known in advance.
An adverb modifies "proud": "justifiably proud" means they have good reason to be. Note that -y changes to -i before -ably.
